description: Four sine oscillators running at low frequency from one shared frequency, each at its own ratio of it

params.text: Sets the frequency all four oscillators are worked out from, 0.015625Hz to 256Hz, starting at 2Hz
Multiplies the shared frequency for that oscillator, 0.0039 times to 256 times, starting at unity; a red lamp comes on as the setting nears the 1/1024Hz to 1024Hz limits
Multiplies the frequency CV by -1, turning that input into an inverting one

inputs.text: A steady voltage here shifts the shared frequency by an octave per volt, and a changing one modulates all four outputs; the channels patched here set the outputs' polyphony

outputs.text: A bipolar sine wave, plus or minus 5V

notes: with Negative CV mode on, 10V at the frequency CV input holds the output voltages where they are
the red lamps beside the ratio knobs go out while the frequency CV input is patched, so they warn of nothing then
menu: Extended Hold Range — multiplies the frequency CV by five, so 10V is enough to stop the oscillators completely
Preset — lists five factory ratio presets, named Golden 1.618, Silver 2.414, Bronze 3.303, Copper 4.236 and Nickel 5.193; each divides every output again by that ratio, from unity at the first
